CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gsc_query_monthly (
 site_url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
 month DATE NOT NULL,
 query TEXT NOT NULL,
 clicks INTEGER NOT NULL,
 impressions INTEGER NOT NULL,
 weighted_position_sum DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY (site_url, query, month),
 CONSTRAINT ck_gsc_query_monthly_first_day CHECK (EXTRACT(DAY FROM month) = 1)
)
ALTER TABLE gsc_detail_sync ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS monthly_backfilled_at TIMESTAMPTZ
